title: add CI artifact signing, syft SBOM, and release-manifests for private-installer
author: Sofia Patel
description:
Motivation: customers running the Private Installer require verifiable, signed release artifacts and provenance (SBOMs + release manifests) for air-gapped / regulated environments. This PR adds CI pipeline steps and release-manifests generation so downstream release engineers and automated installers can fetch signed artifacts and verify provenance before install/upgrade.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a reusable GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/release-artifacts.yml) that: builds release artifacts (installer tarballs, Helm chart packages, operator images), generates an SBOM for each artifact using Syft, signs artifacts and SBOMs with Cosign (OIDC-backed keyless signing + optional KMS-based signing for onboarding customers), and emits a release-manifests JSON blob with checksums, SBOM links, cosign signatures, and semantic version metadata.
- Produces per-arch artifact tarballs and chart packages and uploads them to the internal S3 release bucket (s3://redwood-private-installer-releases) and GCS mirror. Upload uses signed URL step gated behind a release role.
- Adds a release-manifests schema and generator (scripts/release/generate_release_manifests.py) that normalizes artifact metadata across installer, charts, and images. Manifests are uploaded alongside artifacts and are validated in CI.
- Integrates SBOM generation (Syft v0.69) and ensures SBOMs are produced in SPDX and CycloneDX formats.
- Validates signatures in CI via cosign verify and records verification results in the manifest.
- Updates Helm chart packaging workflow to produce provenance files (.prov) and include chart checksums in the manifest.
- Adds unit and integration tests for manifest generation and a smoke test that pulls artifacts from the release bucket, verifies signatures and SBOMs, and performs a dry-run install in a KinD cluster to validate chart semantics.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add Actions workflow for build -> sbom -> sign -> upload
- [x] Generate release-manifests JSON and upload to release bucket
- [x] Add cosign verify check to ensure signatures are present
- [x] Syft SBOM generation in SPDX + CycloneDX
- [x] Helm provenance (.prov) production and checksum collection
- [x] Unit + integration tests and smoke test job (staging)
- [x] Docs: docs/release/README.md explaining signing process and how downstream customers can verify artifacts

Backward compatibility and rollout notes:
- The release-manifests generator uses a new JSON payload but we keep backward compatible fields for older release tooling (fields: artifacts[], charts[], images[], generated_at, signer_identity, signing_method). If a consumer doesn't require manifests, artifact URLs remain unchanged.
- Signing is opt-in for early releases. Existing release automation will continue to upload unsigned artifacts if the cosign step is skipped (controlled by release inputs). The release pipeline defaults to signing for GA releases.

Security notes: 
- Keyless signing via Cosign OIDC is used in Actions by default to avoid storing private keys in the repo. For on-prem releases where customers manage signing keys, an optional flow (KMS/HSM-backed) is documented.
- CI has new IAM role scoped to PutObject for the specific release prefix. The workflow will assume this role via federated credentials.

Testing done: 
- Local unit tests for manifest generator (python pytest)
- GitHub Actions staging run that built artifacts, generated SBOMs, signed with test keys, uploaded to staging bucket, and ran verification smoke test.
- Manual verification of cosign signatures and SBOM artifacts in staging by releases team.

Related Linear/Jira: ENG-4027, SEC-1102.

Notes for release engineers: run ./scripts/release/build_and_sign.sh --version vX.Y.Z to build and produce a release-manifests.json. See docs/release/README.md for verification commands (cosign verify, syft sbom compare, jq manifest validation).

conversation: Miguel Ortega (reviewer): Left a couple of comments on the generate_release_manifests schema - we should include signer_identity and signing_method explicitly. Also: ensure manifest size remains small for indexer performance.
Sofia Patel (author): Addressed in second commit; added signer_identity and limited per-artifact SBOM inline metadata to a checksum + url to keep manifest small.
Amina Rahman (security): Approve after confirming cosign keyless flow is used in Actions; asked to add a note about KMS option for customers - added docs entry.
Connor Lee (release): Verified the staging run and smoke test; requested explicit instructions for rotating signing identity - added rotation steps to docs/release/README.md. Approved.
